module.name: F5 SPK Global Options
module.description: Creates F5SPKGlobalOptions custom resource for cluster-wide SPK configuration including crypto acceleration and hardware offload settings.

required.reason: FLO provides F5SPKGlobalOptions CRD and controller

required.name: cluster_name
required.description: Name of the Kubernetes cluster (used for resource identification)

required.name: options_name
required.description: Name for the global options resource

required.name: flo_ready
required.description: Dependency flag ensuring FLO is ready

optional.name: hardware_offload_enabled
optional.description: Enable hardware offload for network operations

key_outputs.name: options_ready
key_outputs.description: Flag indicating global options are configured

key_outputs.name: options_name
key_outputs.description: Name of the created global options
